title: Accepting What Cannot Be Changed
paragraphs: Setelah kecelakaan mobil meninggalkannya dengan pincang permanen meski menjalani terapi fisik selama berbulan-bulan, Nabil awalnya bergulat dengan kebencian, berulang kali bertanya-tanya mengapa kesulitan khusus ini terjadi padanya. Percakapan dengan kerabat yang lebih tua secara bertahap mengubah perspektifnya, saat wanita itu mengingatkannya bahwa menerima ketetapan Allah tidak mengharuskan berpura-pura kesulitan itu tidak berarti, hanya bahwa melawan kenyataan yang tidak dapat diubah tidak melayani tujuan yang sesungguhnya.

Sepanjang tahun berikutnya, Nabil mendapati dirinya menyesuaikan rutinitas hariannya seputar keterbatasan fisiknya yang baru, menemukan di sepanjang jalan beberapa kegiatan yang tidak pernah ia pertimbangkan sebelumnya tapi benar-benar mulai ia nikmati. Melihat ke belakang beberapa tahun kemudian, Nabil mengakui bahwa penerimaannya tidak datang tiba-tiba atau sepenuhnya, melainkan berkembang secara bertahap melalui pilihan yang berulang dan disengaja untuk melepaskan kebenciannya setiap kali muncul kembali.
answerKey: After a car accident left him with a permanent limp despite months of physical therapy, Nabil initially struggled with resentment, repeatedly wondering why this particular hardship had happened to him specifically. A conversation with an elderly relative gradually shifted his perspective, as she reminded him that accepting Allah's decree did not require pretending the difficulty was insignificant, only that fighting against an unchangeable reality served no genuine purpose. Over the following year, Nabil found himself adjusting his daily routines around his new physical limitations, discovering along the way several activities he had never previously considered but genuinely came to enjoy. Looking back several years later, Nabil acknowledges that his acceptance did not arrive suddenly or completely, but developed gradually through repeated, deliberate choices to release his resentment each time it resurfaced.
